newsitem.title: USA: ARCO to buy additional stake in pipeline.
newsitem.headline: ARCO to buy additional stake in pipeline.

text.p: Atlantic Richfield Co Wednesday said its wholly-owned subsidiary, ARCO Transportation Alaska Inc, has agreed to purchase approximately 25 percent of Mobil Corp's Mobil Alaska Pipeline Co's 4.08 percent interest in the Trans Alaska Pipeline System for $14.1 million.
If approved by the U.S. Department of Interior, the purchase would increase ARCO's ownership interest in the system to 22.29 percent from its current 21.35 percent.

The 800-mile pipeline system carries crude oil from the North Slope of Alaska to the ice-free port of Valdez, where the oil is loaded aboard tankers for delivery to the U.S. West Coast and other ports. Current throughput is approximately 1.4 million barrels of oil per day.
